title: My Family at Work
text:
My mother is a nurse. She works at a big hospital in the city. She helps patients every day. My father is an engineer. He works in an office and builds bridges.

My sister is a chef. She cooks food in a restaurant at night. She likes to make cakes. My brother is a driver. He drives a bus to the airport.

questions.text: What can we guess about the father's job?
options: He works with his hands outside.
He is good with numbers and planning.
He drives people around the city.

questions.text: Why does the sister probably work at night?
options: Because restaurants are busy in the evening
Because she does not like cooking
Because she works at the airport

vocabulary.definition: a person who takes care of sick people
a person who designs and builds things like bridges
a place where people buy and eat meals
a person who drives a car, bus or other vehicle

paragraph_translations: Minha mãe é enfermeira. Ela trabalha em um grande hospital da cidade. Ela ajuda os pacientes todos os dias. Meu pai é engenheiro. Ele trabalha em um escritório e constrói pontes.
Minha irmã é chef. Ela cozinha comida em um restaurante à noite. Ela gosta de fazer bolos. Meu irmão é motorista. Ele dirige um ônibus até o aeroporto.
